entities.title: Content analysis
entities.summary: Turns one file's bytes into the facts zazzle-csharp-indexer stores per blob: git blob id, language, line count, symbols and a one-line digest.
entities.purpose: Holds the pure functions that depend only on a file's bytes and extension: blob analysis, C# extraction with Roslyn and regex-based extraction for other languages. Nothing here reads the disk, the store or the network.
boundaries: Storing the results is the store's job (src/Store.cs); deciding which files to analyse is the index's (src/Index/).
find_symbol and overview in src/Tools/ read the stored symbols and digests; they do not change them.
A change to what this folder produces for a blob must bump Store.ExtractorVersion (see contracts.json).
